rows.note: Use 斜路 as the all-purpose term for an inclined surface connecting two levels.

example.english: This ramp makes it easier for wheelchair users to get up and down.
example.traditional: 呢條斜路方便輪椅上落。
example.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 ce3 lou2 fong1 bin6 leon4 ji2 soeng5 lok6

rows.note: Use 匝道 specifically for a road connector between a freeway and a surface street or another freeway.

example.english: The ramp is just past the next exit, so don't take the wrong turn.
example.traditional: 過咗前面個出口就係匝道，唔好行錯。
example.jyutping: gwo3 zo2 cin4 min6 go3 ceot1 hau2 zau6 hai6 zaap3 dou6 m4 hou2 haang4 co3

rows.note: Use 登機梯 specifically for the mobile stairs attached to an aircraft at an airport.

example.english: The ramp has not been attached to the plane yet, so the passengers have to wait a while.
example.traditional: 架飛機仲未駁好登機梯，乘客要等一陣。
example.jyutping: gaa3 fei1 gei1 zung6 mei6 bok3 hou2 dang1 gei1 tai1 sing4 haak3 jiu3 dang2 jat1 zan6
